stations.title: Your lambdas
stations.gap: A quote that keeps its word

captions: Dorrit quoted a carriage clock, and the customer now hears a higher price.
Kasimir logged more minutes afterwards, and the price she promised did not hold.
You write small rules right where they are used: hours, a quote and a timer.
The quote stays as promised, while the timer adds to the repair itself.
Promises hold and timers stay live. Next, the library's tools get rules to follow.
